theme.vibe: bright preschool road trip with vroom rhythm

pages.text: This is a car. A car has wheels. A car carries people. Vroom, vroom, here we go!

images.alt: A bright red car shown from the side.

pages.text: Round wheels roll on the road. Roll, roll, roll. The car moves forward.

images.alt: A car wheel with a black tire.

pages.text: People sit inside the car. Doors close. Seat belts buckle. Click!

images.alt: A simple seat icon representing a place for a passenger to sit.

pages.text: A driver turns the wheel. The car turns too. Left turn, right turn, slow turn.

images.alt: A blue car shown from the front.

pages.text: Some cars use fuel. Some cars plug in and charge. Both kinds need power to go.

images.alt: A red fuel pump for cars that use gasoline.
A battery icon representing electric power for a car.

pages.text: Cars come in many shapes. Small cars. Big cars. Speedy racing cars. Beep, beep!
At a stop sign, cars stop. Wait, look, and listen with a grown-up.
Cars can take us to the store, the park, or Grandma's house. Roll, ride, stop, go!

images.alt: A yellow taxi car ready for a ride.
